_comment: DEEP-1B (96d L2, big-ann-benchmarks). Anchored on (recall, build_speed) at 1B scale: head_ratio=0.20 keeps the in-memory head index at ~76 GB (1B * 0.20 * 96 * 4B) — bigger is wasteful at 1B once head fits. posting_page_limit=16 matches the 10M tuning; internal_result_num=128 / max_check=16384 widen the search-time pool — SPANN paper SPACEV-1B uses max_check=16384. replica_count=8 is the published 1B sweet spot. num_threads/io_threads=32 caps build wall-clock. metric MUST be L2 to match the official big-ann GT.
